description:
Seventh phase of bl-7c23. Install-time scaffold for ~/.lernie/.

=== Scope ===

1. Makefile 'install' target lays down the harness root skeleton on first run:
   - mkdir -p $(LERNIE_HOME:-~/.lernie)/{adapters,workflows,tools,skills,agents,conversations}
   - install lernie-provider-anthropic to $(LERNIE_HOME)/adapters/
   - install lernie binary to $(INSTALL_PREFIX)/bin/ (default ~/.local/bin/)
   - install lernie-ui-egui binary to $(INSTALL_PREFIX)/bin/
   - generate a default $(LERNIE_HOME)/providers.yaml if absent (don't clobber existing)
   - copy default agent profile to $(LERNIE_HOME)/agents/default/ if absent
2. README quickstart updated: 'make install' to lay everything down, 'lernie new' to scaffold a conversation, 'lernie prompt' to talk to it.
3. Verification step at the end of install: lernie --version + lernie new <tmpdir>/test + cleanup.

=== Constraints ===

- 'install' must be idempotent — re-running it on an existing harness root must not clobber config files (use install -m or test -e guards).
- LERNIE_HOME from the environment overrides the default at install time, matching runtime behavior.

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md.
title: Phase 7: make install harness root scaffold
